messages:
emily: FYI chargeback filed for $2,750 on acct_55900. Cardholder says charge was not authorized. Payment came through our virtual terminal via reseller 'PayLinker' on 2026-05-03. Need quick evidence + hold rec.
billing-bot: Chargeback created 
CB55443322 for txn `T20260503-2a0` 
reason: unauthorized 
dispute window closes 2026-07-01. See case: https://redwood.internal/disputes/CB55443322
raj: pulled the capture: txn_id=T20260503-2a0, AMOUNT=$2,750, METHOD=virtual_terminal, RESELLER=paylinker (reseller_id=pl-88), OPERATOR=email:orders@resell.example
celeste: Virtual terminal session shows operator IP 152.58.120.9 (ASN: AS32789, country: AU). Card BIN country AU, cardholder billing address US. Customer says no AU-based charge.
emily: reseller claims they authorized via phone order with signature on their side. Do we have operator logs from virtual terminal session? Also want merchant-provided proof (signed receipt) and reseller audit trail.
raj: logs: vt_session_id=vt-773, operator logged in with API key resell_key_88. No recorded photo of signature uploaded in our webhook payload. Webhook payload: {"txn":"T20260503-2a0","method":"vt","operator":"pl-88"} returned 200.
fraud-ops: flagging this as medium risk. Recommend: 1) provisional hold on acct_55900, 2) ask reseller for operator identity verification and signed POS receipt, 3) request voice recording if they claim phone auth, 4) preserve logs for dispute response.
emily: placed provisional hold HLD-20260504-03 at 2026-05-04T09:12Z and uploaded preliminary evidence to disputes link above.
celeste: I'll contact Reseller Ops to request signed receipt + operator audit log. If they can't provide, Legal suggests we contest. If they can, we may accept. 
raj: added to case: capture screenshot, vt session logs, operator IP geo, webhook delivery, KYC snapshot for acct_55900. 
billing-bot: Evidence packet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/CB55443322 (access: finance, disputes, legal). 
emily: tagging fraud-ops to follow up; keep this thread updated. :mag:
